remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running package scripts or dev servers, and show the exact command and directory.

content.user_title: Implement Planned Features with Quality Checks
content.value_statement: Feature work can drift when tasks, tests, and verification are not tied together. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through planned implementation, test creation, and completion reporting.
actual_capabilities: Routes feature implementation tasks to work-impl-feature guidance.
Routes test creation tasks to work-write-tests guidance.
Uses Plans.md task states such as TODO, WIP, and complete.
Provides quality gates for TDD, security-sensitive paths, and performance-sensitive work.
Encourages LSP diagnostics, definitions, references, and hover checks.
Includes completion report formats for implementation and test work.
limitations: It does not review code or replace a dedicated security audit.
It assumes the target repository has a Plans.md workflow.
Bash examples may execute project scripts when used by an agent.
It provides process guidance, not framework-specific production code.

use_cases.title: Feature Delivery
use_cases.description: Turn a selected Plans.md task into focused code changes with verification steps.

use_cases.title: Regression Coverage
use_cases.description: Add tests for new behavior and confirm common edge cases after implementation.

use_cases.title: Project Handoff
use_cases.description: Standardize completion notes, changed files, and next-task prompts for team work.

prompt_templates.title: Implement One Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the impl skill to implement the next TODO task in Plans.md. Keep changes focused and report modified files.

prompt_templates.title: Add Tests After Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the test-writing guidance to add missing tests for the latest feature. Cover normal, boundary, and error cases.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Quality Gate First
prompt_templates.prompt: Before implementation, classify the task for TDD, security, and performance concerns. Then implement with the recommended workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Implement With LSP Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Plans.md, inspect related code, implement the task, run relevant diagnostics or tests, and produce a completion report.

output_examples.input: Implement the current WIP task from Plans.md.
output_examples.output: Reports the selected task, files changed, verification commands, and a next-task suggestion.

output_examples.input: Add tests for the new utility behavior.
output_examples.output: Summarizes added test cases, coverage scope, test result status, and remaining gaps.

output_examples.input: Assess the feature before coding starts.
output_examples.output: Shows TDD recommendation, security notes for sensitive paths, and a concise implementation order.

best_practices: Confirm the active Plans.md task before editing files.
Run only verification commands that fit the repository and user context.
Report incomplete work honestly instead of adding placeholder behavior.
anti_patterns: Returning hardcoded values just to satisfy visible tests.
Mixing several Plans.md tasks into one implementation pass.
Running long-lived dev servers without explaining why they are needed.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides feature implementation and test writing from Plans.md tasks.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it write production code by itself?
faq.answer: It provides workflow guidance; the connected agent still edits files and verifies results.

faq.question: Does it require Plans.md?
faq.answer: It is designed around Plans.md, so results are best when that file exists.

faq.question: Can it run commands?
faq.answer: The skill includes Bash-based examples, so users should review commands before execution.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted repositories?
faq.answer: Use caution because package scripts can run arbitrary project code.
